after_visit_summaries.summary: We checked your blood today, including your lithium level. On hot days, stay somewhere cool, drink water regularly, and call us if your shaking gets worse, you feel confused, or you have vomiting or diarrhea. We will call you with your results.
Your annual check-up looked good. You joined the heat-alert program. If a red heat alert happens where you are, your care team will be told automatically. Keep taking your medicines as prescribed.
